title: secret-pattern-detection telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the secret-pattern-detection guard. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "secret-pattern-detection". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO secret material — only category labels.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write, Edit, or NotebookEdit).

file.description: Path of the write target, relative to the consuming repo root when resolvable.

violations.description: Secret-category labels detected in the new content (e.g. "AWS Access Key", "GitHub PAT"), one per matched pattern. NEVER the secret value or the matched line. Empty array on a clean scan (status ok).
